origin.discovery_context: Found while verifying the three MT-017 final-hardening fixes on 2026-07-30. Deferred into its own MT per the Operator rule that an unexpected gap not belonging to the current MT is carried into a future MT in the same work packet so it is not lost.

scope.summary: Close the WP-1 in-product UserManual coverage gaps that are named packet acceptance criteria, and repoint the HBR-MAN-003 self-consistency check at the canonical UserManual corpus so such gaps cannot recur silently.
scope.root_cause: A 2026-07-30 audit found 18 WP-1-relevant UserManual pages already seeded, but TWO gaps that are explicit packet acceptance criteria have ZERO coverage anywhere in the manual module. (1) ExternalEngineImport / external_compat compat lane: zero occurrences across user_manual/seed.rs, registry.rs and behavior_coverage.rs, despite live product code at model_runtime/invariant.rs:43,50,259,281,290,370, model_runtime/types.rs:106, llm/boot.rs:16,109,1268, llm/registry.rs:119 and Dexterity's explicit rejection path at swarm_orchestration/model_lane.rs:5363,8466 (packet.json:202 and the external_engine_import_compat_lane directive at :224). (2) Swarm budget / concurrency cap / circuit breaker / spawn-rejection semantics: max_concurrent, ResourceGovernor, SwarmBudget, concurrency_cap, lifetime_ceiling and breaker_open appear in the manual ONLY as SSE category labels at seed.rs:844, while the live behaviour is at coordinator.rs:803,805,907,919,929,940,952,965, events.rs:81,182 (FR-EVT-SWARM-SPAWN-REJECTED) and breaker.rs. Additionally SwarmCoordinator has 29 incidental mentions but no owning page. ROOT ENFORCEMENT DEFECT: HBR-MAN-003 requires every surface named in the manual to actually exist, but the scanner .GOV/roles_shared/checks/hbr-man-003-scan.mjs reads ONLY the LEGACY manual (MANUAL_CONTENT_PATH = src/backend/handshake_core/src/model_manual/content.rs at :29) and never the canonical user_manual corpus, AND it was deregistered from gov-check on 2026-06-03 (gov-check.mjs:96-98, 'Product-owned, not a governance gate'). The Rust gate compute_behavior_consistency (user_manual/behavior_coverage.rs:451) does enforce routes/symbols/schemas structurally but does NOT read prose, so symbol names inside section() markdown bodies are unverified free text.
forbidden_paths: creating a second manual surface - legacy ModelManual identifiers are ALIASES ONLY per CX-982-001
documenting a surface that does not exist in code (HBR-MAN-003)
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: ExternalEngineImport / external_compat has real UserManual coverage explaining purpose, why it is NOT swarm-spawnable, the Dexterity rejection path, expected inputs/outputs, failure modes and recovery, per CX-982-003.

AC-2: Swarm budget/concurrency semantics have real coverage: max_concurrent, concurrency_cap, lifetime_ceiling, breaker_open, and FR-EVT-SWARM-SPAWN-REJECTED - what the operator sees when a spawn is rejected and how to recover.

AC-3: Each new/changed entry records the HBR-INT-009 diagnostic posture (Flight Recorder / internal_diagnostics / Palmistry) as WIRED, NOT_APPLICABLE-with-reason, or DEFERRED-with-reason, and links the behaviour to Flight Recorder/EventLedger evidence (CX-982-004, HBR-MAN-004).
AC-4: USER_MANUAL_VERSION (user_manual/mod.rs:78) is bumped and the pages resync cleanly; no page is left unseeded or stale.

AC-5: HBR-MAN-003 enforcement is repaired for the canonical corpus. Either repoint/extend hbr-man-003-scan.mjs to read user_manual/seed.rs and re-register it in gov-check.mjs, OR implement the equivalent prose-symbol check in Rust next to compute_behavior_consistency. Record which was chosen and why. A drift MUST fail the gate - prove it by introducing a deliberately bogus surface name, observing the failure, then removing it.

AC-6: The existing exact-set assertion at tests/user_manual_behavior_coverage_tests.rs:270-295 (24 behavior keys) stays green, or is extended deliberately with the new keys and the inverse guard at behavior_coverage.rs:1609-1620 still holds.
scope.risk_if_missed: Two named packet acceptance criteria stay undocumented, so a no-context model or the Operator cannot discover the external-compat lane or understand why a swarm spawn was rejected. Because the HBR-MAN-003 scanner points at the legacy manual and is deregistered, the canonical corpus has no enforced named-surface check and further drift accumulates silently - which is exactly how these two gaps survived.

implementation_notes: Page registration is test-enforced in 8 steps: builder fn -> seed_pages() vec (seed.rs:168-203) -> slug in page_manual_toc all_slugs (:209-249, BFS reachability test at :6155-6192) -> if it owns routes, SurfaceGroup variant + as_str + page_slug + requires_identity_headers + surface! rows in registry.rs -> UserManualToolEntry + BehaviorCoverageRow if it is a behavior proof target -> CompiledSurfaceAnchor + canonical_runtime_surface_id + assert_compiled for new internal behaviour -> SQL insert AND matching template for any new model_lane_schema_registry row -> behavior key added to the exact set at tests/user_manual_behavior_coverage_tests.rs:270-295.

Prefer surface_page() (seed.rs:880-919) for route-owning pages; it auto-injects purpose plus a registry-generated navigation/Routes section. Reference shapes: page_wp1_orchestration_console() (:831-878) and page_model_lane_diagnostics() (:2908-3097).
assert_compiled() (behavior_coverage.rs:176-276) turns a renamed Rust symbol into a COMPILE error - prefer anchoring new claims that way over free prose.

Known related drift, fix or explicitly defer: the legacy MANUAL_VERSION (model_manual/mod.rs:12) is what the stateful bump guard record_manual_drift_guard_run (atelier/model_manual_merge.rs:745,777,782) and hbr-man-001-paired-diff.mjs key on, NOT USER_MANUAL_VERSION - tracked in-code as migration_plan.rs row UMMIG-013.

risks: Documenting a surface that does not exist, which HBR-MAN-003 currently cannot catch for this corpus
Creating a second parallel manual surface instead of extending the canonical one
Claiming the enforcement gap is closed without proving the gate actually fails on drift

The repaired gate is proven to FAIL on a deliberately bogus surface name before being accepted

post_implementation_review_lenses: enforcement gate actually fails on drift
